conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Enforcement Division. This is Officer Daniel Pierce, badge number 475829. With whom am I speaking today?
This is Doris Miller. I got a message saying it was urgent about my taxes?

Yes, Ms. Miller. We are contacting you regarding a federal audit related to your most recent tax filings. There are discrepancies involving unreported cryptocurrency transactions that have triggered a felony-level evasion alert.
Crypto transactions? I don't understand. I only have my Social Security and a little savings.

According to IRS records, several digital asset wallets connected to your name were used for significant transactions over the last two years. Deliberate concealment of crypto capital gains is a serious federal offense.
Oh my... I don't know what any of that means. I never tried to hide anything.

Ms. Miller, under Title 26, Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, intentional tax evasion is prosecutable by up to five years in prison, full forfeiture of assets, and permanent loss of Social Security benefits.
You mean I could lose everything? Even my Medicare? I can't go to jail! Please, is there anything I can do?

At this moment, our system has initiated a case for criminal referral and is preparing to freeze all accounts, including your benefits. However, there is an emergency settlement provision if you act immediately.
A settlement? I don't have much money. Can I just pay what I owe?
The total non-compliance fine is $3,750. This can prevent indictment and asset seizure if settled right now. Payment must be processed securely, either by cryptocurrency transfer or wire.
That's... I can't afford that. I get about $900 a month. Is there another way?

We can accept a partial payment today, with the balance due in 24 hours. Alternatively, you may purchase government-approved prepaid cards or provide full access to your payment app to expedite compliance.
I don't know how to do any of that. I have a debit card. Will that work?

Debit cards are not accepted for settlement compliance. You must visit your local pharmacy or supermarket, purchase $1,500 in prepaid gift cards, Visa, Amazon, or Google Play, and remain on the line with me throughout the process.
But I can't drive. I don't feel well enough. What happens if I can't get the cards?
If you fail to comply, the IRS will immediately issue a warrant for your arrest, freeze all financial accounts, and notify the Department of Justice. This is your last chance to avoid prosecution.
Please, please don't do that. I'll try to get the cards. I just need a little time.
Time is extremely limited. You have 45 minutes to complete this transaction. Once you have the cards, read me every number on the back. Do not hang up or put me on hold for any reason.
Okay, I'll go now. Please don't freeze my money. I need it for my medicine.
Comply precisely and you will avoid further actions. If you disconnect this call, our compliance division will execute the asset freeze without further warning.
